modelChangeSummary: CAL-1.3 changes no formula, coefficient, distribution or band: the known-answer baseline and every Monte Carlo figure are identical to 1.2.0. It records the deployment identity change (one database named iliadis_quickrisk with the iliadis_quickrisk_user account, shared by the questionnaire, QuickRisk Live and Decision Lab), raises the disclaimer version to DISC-1.1, and adds the Decision Lab treatment-analysis layer (paired driver effects over the existing engine, deterministic decision rules, Board Risk Pack). CAL-1.2 corrected four issues identified in an independent quantitative audit: the likelihood question now asks for threat event frequency before control effectiveness, so controls are counted once; Unknown answers use an equal-weight mixture of the available answers instead of a punitive wide band; every response declares an annualised exposure approximation and not realised annual loss totals; input confidence is relabelled, capped at Medium while the calibration is provisional, and reports a sensitivity analysis of the expected value.

visibility.note: parameters.json contains calibration values and must never be bundled into the browser build or exposed by Apache.
